summary.intent: Complete phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization) by closing remaining gaps, getting verification, and creating a PR. Also plan the staging migration from flatfs to pebbleds datastore.
summary.outcome: Phase 19.2 gaps closed (PERF-09 registered, three-point baselines with 75-client bonus documented), PR #342 created and pushed. Staging migration strategy agreed upon as a manual SSH procedure with volume swap approach.

repo: Active CIDs tracked in two DB tables: `pinned_cids` (file content, presence = active) and `folder_ipns` (metadata blobs where `latest_cid IS NOT NULL`). Anything pinned on Kubo not in these tables is stale.
Staging deploy workflow SSHes into VPS at 76.13.151.200, copies files, and runs `docker compose up -d` — no built-in migration hooks.
pebbleds combined with concurrent pins: p95 -13%, p99 -15%, throughput +7% at 50 clients; at 75 clients eliminates failure mode (0 errors vs 10, throughput +44%, p95 -53%).
Concurrent pins alone (without pebbleds) regress throughput by 26% — the two optimizations must ship together.
workflow: Docker volumes cannot be renamed; data migration between named volumes requires an alpine container with cp -a to copy contents.
For one-off datastore migrations, a manual SSH procedure is more pragmatic than over-engineering the deploy workflow.
Parallel cutover strategy for datastore migration: run old and new IPFS nodes simultaneously on same Docker network, use bitswap for content transfer, switch API env var, then clean up.
Before migrating pins to a new node, cross-reference pinned CIDs against the database to avoid carrying over stale pins from failed e2e test runs.

friction: Two background processes (web frontend, API server) were killed unexpectedly during the session, requiring cleanup acknowledgment.
Docker volume naming constraint complicates the staging migration — deploy creates a blank `ipfs_staging` volume that must be replaced post-deploy rather than reusing the migrated volume directly.
open_items: Manual staging migration not yet executed: SSH in, disable API, diff stale CIDs against DB, spin up temp pebbleds container, pin valid CIDs only, deploy via PR, then swap volumes.
Three staging validations pending: live pebbleds deploy, SC1 benchmark on staging, Prometheus histogram verification in Grafana.
Stale CIDs from failed e2e runs still present on current staging IPFS node — will be pruned during migration but not yet addressed.
If datastore migrations become a pattern in future, formalize the migration script into the deploy workflow.
